title: Experiences and achievements
grammar: Present Perfect, Present Perfect vs Past Simple
function: Talk about what you have done in your life

phases.name: Presentation
phases.content: In this unit you will learn the Present Perfect tense to talk about life experiences. You will also compare it with the Past Simple.

phases.name: Discovery
phases.content: Read these sentences. I have visited Paris three times. She has never eaten sushi. We went to Rome last year. Notice: Present Perfect when time is not specific, Past Simple when it is.

phases.name: Guided practice
phases.explanation: With I we use have + past participle.

phases.name: Free practice
phases.prompt: Write 3 sentences about things you have done in your life and 3 about things you did last year.

phases.name: Mini-test
phases.explanation: This morning is finished time, so we use Past Simple.
